title: Superhuman (Wayfinder)
description: A warm off-white page with charcoal text, one brand purple for buttons and links, a lilac for the button on dark, and four deep colour fields (near-black, maroon, teal, indigo) for the bold tiles. Hanken Grotesk at regular weight with tight tracking, 12px radius, hairline shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with a warm near-black page and a lighter purple
chart-1…5 are the deep tile colours (teal, maroon, indigo, purple, ink) and stay deep in both modes; text on them is primary-foreground
accent is the pale lilac of the announcement bar and the quote band; secondary is the lilac button on dark fields; sidebar is the maroon footer
name: superhuman-theme
